boxes.comments: Complete dark autograph head number 29. The 2 has a rounded head and long lower foot; the second figure has an open rounded upper loop and long descending tail, read 9.

Complete short word. Initial p has a long descending stem and right shoulder; the next low cup and return favor u before the dotted i. The compressed medial grouping also permits r, so puis/pris remains local. The final tall, rightward-curving stroke is read s.

Small insertion below the first line, with a rising leader toward the groupe position visible in the original. The word is provisionally read automorphismes: crowded initial a/u/t/o, low m/o/r, descending p, ascender and dotted/low terminal groups. Initial and internal overlapping strokes prevent a secure literal decomposition, so the word remains uncertain; no extra prefix or underlying word is supplied. Clipped surrounding baseline letters and the leader are not completed as text.

The capital has two uprights and a low joining cup, read U, with diagonal cancellation strokes across its body. The separate hyphen and following e/n/d/o/m remain live. The final m is compressed and unexpanded; there is no separately secured terminal stop. The clipped next word at the right edge is excluded.
Looped l, separate apostrophe, tall h, small filled o body and low m ending. The small dark body after h is read as the o within hom. No terminal abbreviation point is separately visible.

Initial accented e, v, dotted i, d loop, low e/n and terminal t support évident. The separate short line lies beneath sur. K has a detached straight bar, followed by a comma. In identifié the initial and later i marks, tall d/t, looped descending f and final accent/e are recoverable near the right edge.

Complete H formula with a small raised 0, both parentheses, internal comma and trailing comma. Both U forms have open upper entries and wavy tildes. The O-shaped argument has a separate underline and a low tilde-U subscript; its looped O form is rendered with mathcal O. No further indices are supplied.

Complete naturelle followed by three separate terminal dots. Low n, small a, tall t, compressed u/r/e, two tall l strokes and final e are visible. A faint oblique stroke below the far right is recorded as surrounding graphic ink, not another word.
Complete sur, open-entry U with a wavy tilde, and comma. The following et is clipped at the right border and is not completed in the reading.

A detached hyphen separates the two groups. In the first group the initial low s/u, a long descending p-like stroke and flattened trailing r/a favor supra, but its tightly joined letters remain uncertain. disants has a d loop and ascender, dotted i, s, low a/n, tall crossed t and terminal s. The unusual prefix is preserved without lexical repair.

Full local revision and following live term are included. A straight bar survives above the heavily crossed first body; a U-like body, dotted low i-like fragment and small raised a/alpha-like fragment are tentatively recoverable. Their readings are localized as doubtful. The diagonals cross the first formula body; the index fragments are provisionally included within that canceled term rather than assigned a new live role. The following open-entry U has a detached straight bar and dotted low i; it is live. No mathematical reconstruction was used to settle the canceled characters.

pris has a tall descending p with shoulder, compressed r, dotted i and final s; sur and entre are legible. The first and final U carry straight bars. The middle U has a short angled cap with a peak and a descending right side; hat is preferred, with tilde retained because the terminal return is compressed. et, three dots, closing parenthesis and final stop are preserved. Clipped neighboring descenders at the crop edges are excluded.

Conjecture begins with a large open C; the j descender loops below the word. A separate continuous underline passes beneath the word and across that descender. B has two clear lobes and its own separate short underline. No title stop is secured.

dans has looped d, small a, low n and terminal s. A continuous underline spans dans and X with a separate raised prime, ending before the equals. The right U has an open upper entry, a small wavy tilde and a larger angular hat above it; both accents are preserved in their vertical order.

The original contains a long, nearly vertical marginal rule beside the conjecture lines, slightly bowed, ending in a darker small bead. This very narrow box was rotated 90 degrees for viewing; its original vertical orientation is restored in the small TikZ figure. Both ends are present. No arrowhead, word or mathematical role is assigned.

Complete six-line oblique margin note, viewed after a clockwise 36-degree rotation. Initial et has an open e and tall t; the next mark has two horizontal strokes and is retained literally as equals. The apostrophe in l'action, two dotted i positions in induite, Gamma with a small raised round 0, pt without expansion, fixe, seul, a separate dash, cf without a supplied stop, and final plus bas with stop are visible. The final f descender crosses the space above the last line; it does not cancel that line.
distance has looped d, dotted i, s, tall crossed t and the low a/n/c/e ending. finie has a long f, two distinct i dots and compressed n between them, followed by e. Both words are complete.

The introductory abbreviation has a dotted i, e and clear final stop; an independent stop between i and e is not secure, so ie./i.e. is retained locally. The full membership formula shows x with tilde, membership sign, open-entry U with tilde and raised Gamma. A tiny loop at the right end of the U tilde is part of its drawn return; no separate Gamma exponent is supplied. Comma, alors and the enumeration 1 with a small raised circle and closing parenthesis are complete. Clipped text at the upper border is excluded.

Complete abbreviated reference th. 3 du § 1. The t has its crossbar, h its tall stem, and a detached abbreviation stop follows. The 3 has an open curved upper portion and lower return; du is compressed; the section sign has crossed S-like portions and the final 1 is upright with a lower hook. Neighboring strokes entering from above and below are excluded.

Complete lower baseline reads scindages distincts) et. In scindages the s/c, dotted i, low n, d ascender, low a and g loop with descending stroke, then e/s are visible. The bottom scan edge clips the lowest g stroke, which is recorded without completing material beyond the image. distincts has the d and t ascenders with the intervening low/dotted letters; closing parenthesis and et are visible. Fragments of the preceding line at the upper edge are excluded.
Complete lower-left foliation 58 in smaller, lighter strokes: the 5 has a broad upper bar and lower curve, and the 8 has two joined loops. Retained as a margin number.

method: Original page and every prescribed fresh crop visually read. Each crop was made once from the original coordinates, autocontrasted, resized to 2800 pixels across with LANCZOS and mildly sharpened. B15 rotated 90 degrees for the narrow marginal rule; B16 rotated clockwise 36 degrees for sloping writing. Only these fresh derived crops were inspected. No OCR, witnesses, first-reading text, packets, notation tables, notes, reports or comparisons were used.
